# DIY Biofabrication Atlas

DIY Biofabrication Atlas is a static, machine-readable atlas of open and low-cost biofabrication, liquid-handling, and adjacent lab automation papers, tools, repos, assets, and event contexts.

## Start here
- /api/index.json
- /api/ontology.json
- /api/graph.json
- /api/papers.json
- /api/tools.json
- /api/repos.json
- /api/topics.json
- /api/assets.json
- /api/events.json
- /api/collections.json

## Notes for LLM consumers
- Prefer `/api/index.json` to discover the dataset.
- Use `/api/ontology.json` for entity definitions, relation labels, and controlled fields.
- `provenanceSource` on asset and event records distinguishes curated manifest entries from heuristic extraction.
- `notes` on curated asset and event records capture provenance caveats.
- Paper records expose metadata and Atlas relationships without local file paths or parsed PDF text.
